name: myth-fact
cta: Questions? Ask us at your next checkup

myths.myth: If my gums bleed, I should stop flossing.
myths.fact: Bleeding gums are often a sign of gum inflammation. Keep flossing gently and let your dentist know.

myths.myth: Sugar-free soda can't hurt my teeth.
myths.fact: Soda is acidic. Even without sugar, it can wear away enamel over time.
Cavities and gum disease often cause no pain early on. Regular checkups catch them sooner.
